title: SignBridge – Sign Language AI Platform
description: AI-driven platform enabling two-way translation between Tunisian Dialect and Tunisian Sign Language. Combines speech recognition, text-to-speech, and BiLSTM-based gesture modeling. Uses MediaPipe for real-time hand and pose landmark extraction.

title: JobKai – AI Employment Platform
description: AI-powered job platform for MENA and Sub-Saharan Africa with resume analysis, interview simulations, and semantic job matching. Microservices architecture with React/TypeScript and FastAPI. Deployed on AKS with CI/CD pipeline including Trivy scanning and SonarQube analysis.

title: Private Data Science Platform
description: Deployed a self-hosted multi-user JupyterHub platform on a Kubernetes cluster (Proxmox/Terraform). Full lifecycle automated with Ansible and Helm for reproducible, scalable research infrastructure.
